section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of intuitive eating using a four-factor scale for adolescents (Dockendorff et al., 2012). Participants rated agreement with statements on a 5-point scale, with Cronbach's α values ranging from 0.70 to 0.81 for individual factors and 0.75 overall. Confirmatory factor analysis was performed on 16 items (after removing Item 17), yielding adequate model fit with RMSEA = 0.057, CFI = 0.935, TLI = 0.919, and SRMR = 0.054.
